name: Mibsam
title: Son of Ishmael
summary: Mibsam was one of Ishmael's twelve sons and thus a grandson of Abraham. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as one of the tribal princes among the Ishmaelites. Another name, Mibsam, also appears in the genealogy of Simeon in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Mibsam as a Son of Ishmael
keyEvents.description: Mibsam was born as one of Ishmael's twelve sons, fulfilling God's promise that Ishmael would become the father of twelve princes.

keyEvents.title: Ishmael's Twelve Sons Named as Tribal Princes
keyEvents.description: Mibsam is counted among the twelve tribal princes descended from Ishmael, who were scattered over a large area in the Arabian desert.

keyEvents.title: God's Promise to Ishmael
keyEvents.description: God had promised Abraham that Ishmael would become the father of twelve princes and grow into a great nation, which was fulfilled through Mibsam and his brothers.

keyEvents.title: Mibsam in the Genealogy of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Mibsam is mentioned again in the extensive genealogy in 1 Chronicles as one of Ishmael's sons, confirming his place in the Bible's family records.

keyEvents.title: Mibsam in the Genealogy of Simeon
keyEvents.description: A name Mibsam also appears in the tribal genealogy of Simeon in 1 Chronicles, as a son of Shallum, which may suggest cultural influence or a shared name.
